segments.he: טור בשם הרמב"ם בסוף הלכות עבודת כוכבים:
segments.en: The Tur in the name of the Rambam at the end of Hilchos Avodah Zarah.
Meaning, even with scissors that cut like a razor. Beit Yosef.

en_segments: The Tur in the name of the Rambam at the end of Hilchos Avodah Zarah.
Meaning, even with scissors that cut like a razor. Beit Yosef.

segments.he: משנה דפ"ה דפאה וכחכמים וכאשר הגהתי כן הוא ברמב"ם וטור:
segments.en: Mishnah, chapter 5 of Peah, in accordance with the Sages. As I emended the text, so it appears in the Rambam and the Tur.
The Rambam likewise wrote this in chapter 9.
